theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_rotation_divergence
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → tangentialDivergence n M (fun y : Euclid P => g y • (inner ℝ y a • e - inner ℝ y e • a)) x = fderiv ℝ g x ((approxTangentPlane n M x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a))
